qualification.details: AYUSH MO (RBSK): BAMS/BHMS from a recognized Institution/University with valid Registration License from the Registrar Board of Homoeopathic/Ayurvedic System of Medicine, Meghalaya Shillong. District Nursing Instructor: MSc Nursing/BSc Nursing with a minimum of 2 years of experience and good communication skills. Block Coordinator: Post Graduate in Rural Development/Social Work/Hospital or Healthcare Management/Public Health with a minimum of 2 years of experience in central scheme and program implementation. Ophthalmic Assistant: Two years diploma course in Optometry/Bachelor of Science in Optometry from a recognized Institution/University. GNM: Bachelor's Degree/GNM qualification recognized by the Nursing Council of India with at least one year of experience in a Hospital. ANM: Matriculate with a certificate course of 18 months duration on FHW training from a recognized institution, registered in Meghalaya Nursing Council. AYUSH Medical Officer Cum Community Health Officer (CHOs): BHMS from a recognized University with a valid Registration License from the Registrar Board of Homoeopathic System of Medicine, Meghalaya Shillong. AYUSH Medical Officer (Ayurvedic): BAMS from a recognized University with a valid Registration License from the Registrar Board of Ayurvedic System of Medicine, Meghalaya Shillong.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for DHS South Garo Hills Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for DHS South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the DHS South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 29 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue within the specified registration time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for AYUSH MO (RBSK) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the AYUSH MO (RBSK) post in the District Health Society South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the AYUSH MO (RBSK) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BAMS/BHMS degree from a recognized institution and hold a valid Registration License from the Registrar Board of Homoeopathic/Ayurvedic System of Medicine, Meghalaya Shillong.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the official notification states that there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DHS South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026 involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The registration time for the walk-in interview is from 09:30 AM to 10:30 AM. Candidates are advised to arrive within this window.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the advertised positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised positions in the DHS South Garo Hills Recruitment 2026 is on a Contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held in Baghmara, South Garo Hills, Meghalaya. The exact venue details are usually provided in the official notification.
